Adding or upgrading a model is ONE clean edit here bound to a level (see model_slot_in). Providers at a level are REPLACEABLE. Invariant policy lives in AGENTS.md/DOCTRINE.md; everything that moves with the market lives here.

Also FIRST in the gating order and the Anthropic-family gate seat (owner ruling 2026-08-25; BullshitBench 0.94 detect), served across live Claude seats (teamclaude). NEVER the default implementer where a worker seat is live. Pin 4.8; Opus 5.0 forbidden (5.1+ allowed).

opus-5.reason: The ONE hard invariant of this system: Opus 5.0 must never run (default OR reviewer). Matched EXACTLY to 5.0 — bare opus-5, opus-5-0/.0, or a 5.0 build/date stamp — by bin/mborch.py is_opus5_zero; it is NOT a wildcard over the 5-series. Opus 5.1+ are NOT forbidden: they slot in via capability+prowess (see model_slot_in). Pin stays opus-4.8. Add other ids/aliases here to forbid them (extensible data; the code enforces).

review_order_note: GATING fallback order (owner ruling 2026-08-25, Orchestration Retro): Opus 4.8 first (Anthropic gate), then Codex Sol (OpenAI), then Review E (independent open-weight). Fable is REMOVED from the gating order — it measured worst on nonsense detection (BullshitBench), so it never gates; it stays a registered provider for optional architecture passes only. A stronger new frontier model slots ahead by prowess — the admin updates this list when adding one. resolve-route computes the LIVE chain from this order + usage-status tiers, preferring tier=available over tier=reserve so a self-imposed cap never strands a seat. Cross-family = one pass from two DIFFERENT families (Anthropic gate = Opus 4.8; OpenAI = Sol; open-weight = Review E).

model_slot_in._note: CLEAN SLOT-IN for a new/updated model (Opus 5.1, Fable 5.1, a successor to Fable/Sol, a new implementer). It is ONE edit here — no code or prose changes:
steps: 1. Add a provider entry: id, level (the durable slot it fills), family, kind, model (the new id), functions, capabilities, prowess, billing, detect.
2. To replace an incumbent, set `supersedes: <old-id>` and remove/disable the old entry; keep the SAME level so routing is unchanged.
3. If it should join review, add it to review_order at the position its prowess earns and set review_eligible:true.
4. Run bin/doctor.py (validates level/family/forbidden/order) and bin/smoketest.py. Done — the router and recommendations pick it up.
model_slot_in.supersedes_note: A provider may declare `supersedes` naming the id it replaces; doctor warns if both an entry and its superseded id remain enabled.
